title_en.v1.title: 3 Homemade Skin-Care Products: Multani Mitti Face Wash, Sesame-Saffron Face Oil and Besan Body Wash
title_en.v1.reason: All three recipes and their ingredients are explicit in the transcript.

detailed_summary.v3.overview: The video gives three homemade recipes. The face wash combines Multani mitti with a pinch of turmeric and is mixed with water immediately before use. The face moisturizer/serum uses a double boiler: 100 ml cold-pressed sesame oil, 1 teaspoon sandalwood powder and about 10 saffron strands are warmed for roughly 20 minutes; after cooling, one optional vitamin-E capsule is mixed in and the oil is filtered. The body-wash powder combines besan, 30 g Multani mitti and 1 teaspoon turmeric. The creator recommends storing the dry powders airtight and mixing with water at use time. For very dry skin, the transcript suggests adding oil, curd, milk or milk powder. The recipes are practical records, but individual irritation and allergy risk still matter.
